Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 41% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A tight ring of 158 clones as a result holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. That is 4 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
